positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Contributor to SoftIron's on-prem private cloud appliance which tightly integrated projects such as QEMU, Ceph, and OpenNebula into a highly-opinionated custom Linux OS.  Designed, built, tested, and supported a customer-focused tool to automatically migrate selected virtual machines from VMware-based environments to SoftIron-based environments, including disk image conversion and automatic installation of KVM guest drivers.  Application written in Python3 using Flask, Celery, Gunicorn, Redis, and Nginx providing an API to a React web frontend.  Built internal tools in Python and Go used for improving developer experience and iteration speed for dev/test loops.  Evaluate product compatibility with open source DevOps and infrastructure as code tools such as Ansible and Terraform, upstreaming patches as appropriate.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: Maintained the Python-based bare metal provisioning tool used in ServiceNow datacenters, making modifications as necessary to support new hardware and machine configurations.  Provided support and triage for the tool to developers and ops teams.  Maintained puppet code used for OS-level configuration management.  Developed GitLab CI/CD pipelines to build in-house RPM packages of Python3.x releases and PyPI releases.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Continue as a core developer of Stacki as an open source project.  Development of Stacki's integration with NetApp storage arrays, as well as continued development of Stacki's automated build and test integration.  Continued open source community involvement.  Supervise, mentor, train, recruit interns as well as new hires.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Core developer for the open source bare metal Linux deployment tool, Stacki.  Interviewed on FLOSS Weekly, representing the Stacki project.  Developed Stacki's automated build environment and continuous integration projects from scratch.  Wrote Stacki's integration to configure NetApp E-Series storage arrays.  Fielded support questions for open source users and respectfully spread awareness of Stacki across a variety of social media as well as supporting paid customers.  Supervise and mentor interns and junior developers.  StackIQ was acquired by Teradata.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on various projects as part of the Teradata Virtual Storage team, including Ceph integration, iSCSI connection management, automated testing with Packer and Vagrant, and automated deployments with Ansible and Python.
